note: Standard Bank Malawi's revised fees and commissions (effective 1 February 2025): the Silver bundle costs 4,200 kwacha a month before the 16.5% VAT every fee carries, 4,893 in all; per-transaction charges on the pay-as-you-transact option aren't modelled.

sources.title: Standard Bank Malawi, Revised Fees and Commissions (effective 1st February 2025)
sources.said: Revised Fees and Commissions Effective 1st February 2025 ... All Fees and Commissions are subject to 16.5% VAT in compliance with the VAT amendment Act 2021. ... Monthly Bundle Fee Silver MWK 4,200.00
